method: Actual Ruffle AVM1 telemetry versus HTML numerical model; original files unchanged, private diagnostic copies not distributed

defaultTrace.scope: Consecutive sampled actual AVM1 steps in steady sample windows, with live parameter values and live state as seed. MovieClip display coordinates have 0.05 px twip quantization; internal numeric states use relative tolerance 1e-8. This does not verify every control combination or all initializations.

numeric.scope: Consecutive sampled actual AVM1 steps in steady sample windows, with live parameter values and live state as seed. MovieClip display coordinates have 0.05 px twip quantization; internal numeric states use relative tolerance 1e-8. This does not verify every control combination or all initializations.

results.scope: Private read-only Trace observer in a separate empty MovieClip; original AVM1 action bytes are intact. Actual original pointer events are used. Unmodified-byte playback audit is separately recorded in flash-runtime-report.json. No assertion of diagnostic/original pixel equivalence.
